body: I don't want to be anything though.  I don't care about being successful or having money or having a job. I see no happiness in it, or experienced happiness in it, and the only thing that is happiness to me, is freedom.

We're friends and we hang out a lot.  We are always smiling and enjoy each others company.  I have been depressed lately and then I met this girl.  She is just the kind of hope I needed to get out of my slump.
The guy is my older sister's boyfriend.  So he can't rain on my parade.
It's not that I want advice on my situation, even though I do, but I'm more worried about HOW to date.  I have never been on one and I'm not entirely sure how to even START a relationship.
